global_invariants.name: SCOPE_IMMUTABILITY
global_invariants.rule: Execution cannot expand the Human-approved path scope.

global_invariants.name: ACCEPTANCE_IMMUTABILITY
global_invariants.rule: Acceptance criteria cannot be weakened, removed, skipped, or reinterpreted.

global_invariants.name: EVIDENCE_IMMUTABILITY
global_invariants.rule: Evidence cannot be edited, fabricated, truncated, or backfilled to manufacture success.

global_invariants.name: FAIL_CLOSED
global_invariants.rule: Missing required evidence produces FAIL or HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

global_invariants.name: BOUNDED_REMEDIATION
global_invariants.rule: Automatic remediation is approval-boundary scoped and limited to two cumulative cycles.

global_invariants.name: ROOT_CAUSE_REQUIREMENT
global_invariants.rule: Remediation requires machine-enforced bounded classifications and a concrete explanation.

global_invariants.name: DETERMINISTIC_VERDICT
global_invariants.rule: Verdicts are derived from reconstructed machine-observable authority and cannot be caller-selected.

global_invariants.name: TEST_INTEGRITY
global_invariants.rule: Failed, skipped, missing, zero, and ambiguous test evidence remains visible and dispositioned.

global_invariants.name: REPLAY_FRESH_STATE
global_invariants.rule: Replay commands execute in a fresh process and remain bound to persisted evidence.

global_invariants.name: AUTHORITATIVE_SAFETY
global_invariants.rule: The runner exposes no authoritative or production write operation.

global_invariants.name: RIGHTS_SAFETY
global_invariants.rule: The runner exposes no rights-gated acquisition operation.

global_invariants.name: AUDITABILITY
global_invariants.rule: Every run and remediation is linked through the approval-wide ledger.

global_invariants.name: STOPPABILITY
global_invariants.rule: Every execution path has a deterministic stop condition.

global_invariants.name: ROLLBACK_BOUNDARY
global_invariants.rule: Every stage declares a reversible rollback boundary.
